title.en: Grok API Key Complete Guide (2026): Setup, Pricing, Models & Best Practices
title.zh: Grok API Key 完全指南（2026）：开通、定价、模型与最佳实践

excerpt.en: Everything you need to know about Grok API keys: how to register on xAI, create keys, understand Grok-2 vs Grok-3 vs Grok-4.5 pricing, fix common errors, and build real-time-aware applications.
excerpt.zh: 关于 Grok API Key 的一切：如何在 xAI 注册、创建密钥、理解 Grok-2 / Grok-3 / Grok-4.5 定价差异、排查常见错误，以及构建实时信息应用。

en: Grok is the AI model family developed by xAI, the company founded by Elon Musk. Unlike other LLMs, Grok has real-time access to information through X (formerly Twitter), giving it a unique advantage for current-events queries. The model also has a more humorous, less filtered personality that distinguishes it from GPT-4o and Claude.
The Grok API is fully OpenAI-compatible, meaning you can use the same SDK and code patterns with just a base URL change. This makes migration from OpenAI straightforward.
zh: Grok 是 xAI 开发的 AI 模型系列，xAI 由马斯克创立。与其他 LLM 不同，Grok 通过 X（原 Twitter）获取实时信息，在时事查询方面有独特优势。模型风格更幽默、过滤更少，与 GPT-4o 和 Claude 形成差异。
Grok API 完全兼容 OpenAI 格式，只需更改 base URL 即可使用相同的 SDK 和代码模式，从 OpenAI 迁移非常简单。

heading.en: Grok Model Lineup: Grok-2, Grok-3, and Grok-4.5
heading.zh: Grok 模型阵容：Grok-2、Grok-3 和 Grok-4.5

en: xAI offers three main Grok models. Grok-2 is the cost-effective option for lighter workloads. Grok-3 is the flagship with the strongest reasoning and multimodal capabilities. Grok-4.5, released July 2026, is the first model co-trained with Cursor, specifically optimized for coding and agentic tasks with 1.5 trillion parameters.

For most general-purpose applications, Grok-3 provides the best balance of performance and cost. For coding tasks, Grok-4.5 offers superior token efficiency. For cost-sensitive workloads, Grok-2 remains a solid choice.
zh: xAI 提供三个主要 Grok 模型。Grok-2 适合轻量负载，性价比高。Grok-3 是旗舰模型，推理和多模态能力最强。Grok-4.5 于 2026 年 7 月发布，是首个与 Cursor 联合训练的模型，1.5 万亿参数，专为编程和 Agent 任务优化。
通用场景下 Grok-3 提供最佳性能与成本平衡。编程任务推荐 Grok-4.5，Token 效率更优。成本敏感场景可选用 Grok-2。

heading.en: How to Get a Grok API Key
heading.zh: 如何获取 Grok API Key

en: Getting a Grok API key is straightforward. Go to console.x.ai, sign up with your email or X account, bind a payment method, and create an API key in the dashboard. The key is shown only once at creation time, so copy it immediately.
There is no permanent free tier, but xAI has offered promotional credits in the past. Check the console dashboard after signing up for any active promotions.
For a detailed step-by-step walkthrough including screenshots and code examples, see our dedicated guide: [[guide:how-to-get-grok-api-key|How to Get a Grok API Key]].
zh: 获取 Grok API Key 很简单。访问 console.x.ai，用邮箱或 X 账号注册，绑定支付方式，然后在后台创建 API Key。Key 只在创建时显示一次，请立即复制保存。
API 没有永久免费套餐，但 xAI 曾推出过促销额度。注册后可在控制台查看当前活动。
如需包含截图和代码示例的详细步骤，请参阅我们的专门指南：[[guide:how-to-get-grok-api-key|如何获取 Grok API Key]]。

en: Grok 4.5 is particularly powerful for coding tasks. Its API uses the same OpenAI-compatible format, with the model ID grok-4.5. If you already use the OpenAI SDK, migration requires only two changes: swap the base URL to https://api.x.ai/v1 and replace your API key.

For a comprehensive guide covering registration, first API call, error handling, and pricing comparison against Claude Sonnet 5, see our detailed guide: [[guide:grok-45-api-key-setup-2026|How to Get a Grok 4.5 API Key]].
zh: Grok 4.5 在编程任务上特别强大。API 使用相同的 OpenAI 兼容格式，模型 ID 为 grok-4.5。如果已在用 OpenAI SDK，只需更改两处：将 base URL 改为 https://api.x.ai/v1 并替换 API Key。
如需涵盖注册、首次 API 调用、错误处理及与 Claude Sonnet 5 定价对比的完整指南，请参阅：[[guide:grok-45-api-key-setup-2026|Grok 4.5 API Key 申请教程]]。

en: Grok models are priced competitively. Grok-4.5 costs $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens — significantly lower than Claude Opus 4.8 ($15/$75) while delivering comparable benchmark performance.

The cost advantage is amplified by token efficiency: Grok 4.5 completes complex coding tasks using roughly half the tokens of comparable models. Input and output tokens are billed separately, with discounts for cached prompts on some models.
zh: Grok 模型定价有竞争力。Grok-4.5 输入 $2/百万 Tokens、输出 $6/百万 Tokens，远低于 Claude Opus 4.8（$15/$75），同时提供可比的基准性能。
成本优势因 Token 效率而放大：Grok 4.5 完成复杂编程任务的 Token 消耗约为竞品的一半。输入和输出 Token 分别计价，部分模型有缓存提示词折扣。

en: Grok-2: Budget option for light workloads
Grok-3: Flagship model for general-purpose use
Grok-4.5: $2 input / $6 output per million tokens, optimized for coding
Claude Sonnet 5: $3 input / $15 output per million tokens (comparison)
All models: prepaid credits model, no permanent free tier
zh: Grok-2：轻量负载的经济选择
Grok-3：通用旗舰模型
Grok-4.5：$2 输入 / $6 输出（每百万 Tokens），专为编程优化
Claude Sonnet 5：$3 输入 / $15 输出（每百万 Tokens，对比参考）
所有模型：预付额度模式，无永久免费套餐

heading.en: Quick Start: Your First Grok API Call
heading.zh: 快速开始：第一次 Grok API 调用

en: The xAI API is OpenAI-compatible. Use the OpenAI SDK with the xAI base URL and your Grok API key:
zh: xAI 的 API 兼容 OpenAI 格式。使用 OpenAI SDK，配合 xAI 的 base URL 和你的 Grok API Key：

caption.en: Calling the Grok-3 model through the xAI API using the OpenAI Python SDK
caption.zh: 使用 OpenAI Python SDK 通过 xAI API 调用 Grok-3 模型

en: Always store your API key as a server-side environment variable. Never expose it in client-side code or public repositories. Use descriptive key names in the console so you can track which application each key belongs to.

Monitor your usage through the xAI console dashboard. Set up billing alerts to avoid unexpected charges. For production applications, implement exponential backoff retry logic for 429 rate limit errors.
Take advantage of Grok's real-time information access for applications that need current-events awareness — this is a capability that most other LLMs cannot match.
zh: 始终将 API Key 存储为服务端环境变量，不要在客户端代码或公开仓库中暴露。在控制台中使用描述性 Key 名称，便于追踪每个 Key 对应的应用。
通过 xAI 控制台监控用量，设置账单告警以避免意外费用。生产环境中，为 429 限流错误实现指数退避重试逻辑。
利用 Grok 的实时信息访问能力构建需要时事感知的应用——这是大多数其他 LLM 无法匹配的能力。

answer.en: The Grok API is not free. It uses a prepaid credits model with no permanent free tier. New accounts may receive promotional credits for initial testing. After credits are used, you need to add funds to continue.
answer.zh: Grok API 不是免费的。采用预付额度模式，无永久免费套餐。新账户可能会获得促销额度用于初始测试，用完后需要充值才能继续使用。

question.zh: Grok API 兼容 OpenAI 吗？

answer.en: Yes. The xAI API is fully OpenAI-compatible. Use the OpenAI SDK with base URL https://api.x.ai/v1 and your Grok API key. The request format is the same — just change the model name to grok-2, grok-3, or grok-4.5.
answer.zh: 完全兼容。xAI 的 API 完全兼容 OpenAI 格式。使用 OpenAI SDK，将 base URL 设为 https://api.x.ai/v1 并使用你的 Grok API Key。请求格式相同，只需将模型名改为 grok-2、grok-3 或 grok-4.5。

question.en: Which Grok model should I use?
question.zh: 我应该用哪个 Grok 模型？

answer.en: Use Grok-3 for general-purpose applications needing the best reasoning and multimodal capabilities. Use Grok-4.5 for coding and agentic tasks — it offers superior token efficiency. Use Grok-2 for cost-sensitive, lighter workloads.
answer.zh: 通用场景用 Grok-3，推理和多模态能力最强。编程和 Agent 任务用 Grok-4.5，Token 效率更优。成本敏感的轻量负载用 Grok-2。

question.en: What makes Grok different from ChatGPT or Claude?
question.zh: Grok 与 ChatGPT 或 Claude 有什么不同？

answer.en: Grok's main differentiator is real-time information access through X's data pipeline, allowing it to answer questions about current events. It also has a more humorous, less filtered personality. For coding, Grok 4.5 was co-trained with Cursor, making it especially strong at multi-file project understanding.
answer.zh: Grok 的主要差异是通过 X 数据管道访问实时信息，可以回答时事问题。风格更幽默、过滤更少。编程方面，Grok 4.5 与 Cursor 联合训练，在多文件项目理解上格外出色。
